top.title: Masked men beat Palestinian workers hired by Israeli army
top.summary: A group of Palestinian workers hired by the Israeli army were attacked by masked men near Ramallah. Josh Reiner, a Haaretz journalist, post video of "Jewish terrorists" near the village of Al-Mu'ayyer, close to Ramallah. "Masked men arrive in a pickup truck with iron bars and clubs and beat workers from the Palestinian Electric Company who had arrived *by prior arrangement* with the IDF to carry out infrastructure work. 3 injured, one seriously," he wrote on X. תראו האירוע המטורף הזה של מחבלים…
